target.body:
Updated [GitVersion.MsBuild](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion) from 6.8.1 to 6.8.2.
Release notes _Sourced from [GitVersion.MsBuild's releases](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/releases)._ ## 6.8.2 As part of this release we had [10 commits](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/compare/6.8.1...6.8.2) which resulted in [4 issues](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/milestone/88?closed=1) being closed. __Dependencies__ - [__!5022__](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/pull/5022) (deps): Bump SharpYaml from 3.11.0 to 3.12.0 by [dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) - [__!5024__](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/pull/5024) (build deps): bump step-security/harden-runner from 2.19.4 to 2.20.0 in /.github/workflows by [dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) - [__!5027__](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/pull/5027) (build deps): bump the codeql group across 1 directory with 3 updates by [dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) __Improvements__ - [__#​5026__](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/issues/5026) [ISSUE]: Incorrect label placeholders should not throw exception by [robertcoltheart](https://github.com/robertcoltheart) resolved in [__!5025__](https://github.com/GitTools/GitVersion/pull/5025) by [robertcoltheart](https://github.com/robertcoltheart) __Contributors__ 2 contributors made this release possible. __SHA256 Hashes of the release artifacts__ -
